label: Commands
description: Discovers Commands from effective file inventories and executes resolved implementations through the Tasks service.

commandDescriptor.description: Frozen lightweight metadata for one discovered Command; it does not contain or load the implementation.

id.description: Command identifier derived from its path below the owning commands directory.

moduleId.description: Owning module ID, or xshell for a framework Command.

label.description: Authored Command label, or an empty string when omitted.

description.description: Authored Command description, or an empty string when omitted.

tags.description: Frozen authored Command tag identifiers in declaration order.

category.description: Authored category when available; otherwise the owning module ID.

icon.description: Authored Command icon, or an empty string when omitted.

path.description: Normalized virtual path of the Command JavaScript file.

size.description: Physical Command file size in bytes.

commandDescriptorList.description: Frozen array of Command descriptors sorted by Command ID.

commandListOptions.description: Optional exact ownership filters and case-insensitive text query across Command metadata.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against ID, label, description, and tags.

commandRunOptions.description: Options used to resolve and execute one Command.

id.description: Command identifier resolved through the command Loader.

args.description: Named Command arguments. Values are validated and ordered using the Command execute contract.

background.description: Whether the Task is globally visible and may continue independently of its initiating UI.

task.description: Stable live Task handle created by tasks.run(). It exposes Task observation, cancellation, output, wait, and result APIs.

list.description: Synchronously lists Commands from effective framework and module file inventories, optionally matching ID, label, description, and tags without loading implementations.

returns.description: Frozen descriptors sorted by Command ID.

getInfo.description: Synchronously gets one discovered Command descriptor by exact ID without loading its implementation.

returns.description: Frozen Command descriptor, or null when the ID is unknown.

run.description: Asynchronously loads a Command and validates its arguments before creating a Task. Resolves to the live Task handle; Command execution continues through that Task.

returns.description: A Promise resolving to the newly created live Task handle.
